items.text: [p align="start"]Career Mode Updates
Breakthrough Timing Adjustments
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/e98d19793ac3519abd62bbb93f65a4439011e6d1.png"]

[p align="start"]Previously, when a player reached the required number of Athletic Points during play in the final month of the season, their Breakthrough would occur after the start of the new season.
We have adjusted this so that eligible players now have their Breakthrough during the Season Results.
[p align="start"]In conjunction with this change, you can now set player Breakthrough Trainings in advance.
Saving Fast-Forward Settings for Career Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/0c5d0935db5dce4d10871978250e92e685e3af31.png"]

[p align="start"]Previously, to prevent unintended behaviour, the Fast-Forward setting for Advance Schedule was reset to its default setting when starting the first month of a new season and upon the first entry into Career Mode after launching the game.
However, as we felt this created more inconvenience than benefit, we have adjusted the feature so that the previous setting is now saved until changed by the user.
When No Players Are Eligible for Special Training
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/5bd7e31990b7886738ca51b334ade80545ac0287.png"]
[p align="start"]We have adjusted the display so that no badge appears when there are no players eligible for Special Training.
In addition, the confirmation dialog will no longer appear when tapping Advance Schedule.
Guide Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/b98f67b715afbd80b880df760118d2c43f325138.png"]
[p align="start"]We have made two adjustments to the Guide.
1. The guide will no longer appear when no players are eligible for Special Training.
2. The guide will now appear when the Home Stadium can be expanded.
[p align="start"]Dream Team Mode Update
Adding Career Mode Players to Team Registration
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/e2941612aff3404d9478bb925829abbb7ead165d.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c46ef7645745229d1f5a4b4e97092a235f89c435.png"]
[p align="start"]Previously, Career Mode players could only be registered as part of Squads, making them difficult to use in Dream Team Mode. Going forward, they can also be registered normally.
This is the biggest change we're introducing in this update.

We made this change to address several concerns, including the difficulty of activating certain Formation Combos and the challenges posed by Career Mode-exclusive player events when only Squad Registration is available. We're hoping this fix makes Career Mode even more enjoyable.
[p align="start"]But with this change, Squads are effectively the same as your Team Lineups, and the difference becomes a bit confusing.
That said, addressing this issue would involve updating multiple interconnected features, and it would've taken ages to release it.
We hope to work toward an ideal solution over time, but we're taking a realistic approach for now and delivering what we can at this stage.
Registered Player Performance Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/2ab54850070024ea9080edc3aaebb2b504a4d391.png"]
[p align="start"]As mentioned above, because you can now register Career Mode players, a significantly larger number can be registered at once.
To ensure that this does not impact the Registered Players screen, we've optimised performance.
WPS Matchmaking Adjustments
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/7db83276af2d890282a902a17ee8e51d10bf9af5.png"]
[p align="start"]As announced here, the following changes will be implemented.
[p align="start"]• Matchmaking adjustments
• Rating calculation adjustments
[p align="start"]Please see WPS Season 9 Extension and Changes Coming in Season 10 for more details.
[p align="start"]Next up is event updates.
PIZZA-LA Cup & Missions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/cd67fd579c77290679246a8119d43e7d563a14f6.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/3362129d0d7a6c8b33d22627137f70e1cdc98ea9.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/597497e54ca2de72d717d2b125ebdbdd0c717e0c.png"]
[p align="start"]Starting this update, you'll be able to host special cups in Career Mode.
We'll be kicking things off with the limited-time PIZZA-LA Cup as our first event.
Open in all leagues, the PIZZA-LA Cup features exclusive missions, with a variety of rewards available for those who complete them.
Further details about the event will be announced at a later date, so stay tuned!
Added a Second Kick the Target Dice Event
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/5f3c09efdd53edbe57f6d678d45298754af1a090.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/ca8fa557ad1ca37c7be5458dd3ad52acd2a5cc53.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/9ac92a1368836a7f7f08fa2a2a8038bd30cc5c74.png"]
[p align="start"]We're planning to hold the next Dice Event shortly after the release of Ver. 2.4.
In this Dice Event, there will be two Kick the Target spaces instead of one.
We've also added an option to skip the Kick the Target animation.
Keep your eyes peeled for future announcements.
[p align="start"]I'll summarize the remaining major updates in this section.
We've received a great deal of feedback, particularly about upgrading accessories.
While we plan to address these requests over time, we'd first like to introduce the improvements included in this update.
Equip Recommended Accessories
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/bd39408e598a2373735bb1ad81ad1b9dd60e637a.png"]
[p align="start"]We understand that many players find it difficult to decide which accessories to equip to their Prime Players.
In fact, our data shows that a large number of players were not equipping accessories to their players at all.
[p align="start"]To address this, we've implemented a new 'Recommended Equipment' feature designed to make the process easier.

Of course, there will be cases where selecting accessories individually yields better results, particularly when options and Full Set Effects come into play. That said, this feature should lower the barrier to taking the all-important first step of equipping accessories in the first place.
We hope you find this feature useful.
Expanded Accessory Filters
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/7e027774afa98c92cf0695e4cb9c0347e90eb0f9.png"]
[p align="start"]We've enhanced the filtering features based on player feedback.
A new 'Effects' tab has been added, allowing accessories to be filtered by Bonus Effect and Full Set Effect.
By checking options such as 'Decisiveness Up' and 'Shooting Instinct Up,' you can filter accessories that have those effects.
Checking Accessory Details
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/038d2648a43ce9d52f3ea6c01772fabb4380fd4a.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fe3a53ad443719a208eb5782c40a80813df2283e.png"]

[p align="start"]Previously, checking accessories on the Accessory Drop screen required reopening the details screen each time. With this update, you can now select ◀▶ shown in the image to switch between accessories and view their details more easily.
Added Collect All for Daily and Weekly Missions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/0f98c4b3468f58cd1f92d3c801e53347cb35fa67.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c32f0f232c8f89af21a15fa1ef6f6492cf4a6931.png"]
[p align="start"]Until now, points and cumulative rewards had to be collected in two separate steps.
To address this, we've made it possible to claim both points and cumulative rewards with a single tap.
Claiming Pass Reward
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/651c74d0ea0bc076b7ae6c9f5b3d78f8172629ba.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/ab561030f812bf675f9775bf40c89ddcc8a2d489.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/2e630bfb6280d140868fe01c60d9d169bf456928.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/01b229df481a24d1f727eeb4bdafa8dec104619c.png"]

[p align="start"]We've adjusted the flow so that, after navigating to the Gift Box from a message to claim your rewards, you can now return to the previous screen with a single action instead of having to close two screens.
New Assistant Added
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/55526a299397957ae0b92179e9aa3c78754dd2cd.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/8833f3da1d0b93bb137749965a2cffc94a6c5c70.png"]
[p align="start"]We're also excited to announce that Seika from Neontetra, a familiar face from SEGA FCC TV, has been added to the game as a new assistant!
She'll have her own Predicament, and Hideyuki, her bandmate, will make an appearance as well.
Be sure to check it out in-game for yourself!

notes.title: [p align="start"]The following changes have been made

items.text: [p align="start"]• Added Home screen announcement for new Scouting lineups
• Added badges for new shop lineups
• Fixed issue when offsides occurred where the on-screen situation didn't match the final decision
*Has no impact on balance
• Adjustments to certain goalkeeper behaviours
*Has no impact on balance
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/ed3a841a4b0eb0460824db9ec7f639ac10b950de.png"]Here is our roadmap that we introduced during SEGA FCC TV #11.
As Producer Hisai explained in the broadcast, we're developing the game with the mindset that building unique teams is more fun than everyone using the same strong player.
[p align="start"]In terms of new features to keep to that ideal, we're adding Career Mode registered players in Ver. 2.4, and Next-Level Breakthroughs plus a new version of Career Mode in Ver. 3.0.
[p align="start"]Career Mode registered players refers to just that. Your Career Mode players who could only be registered within entire Squads will now be registered as individual players.
[p align="start"]We are currently developing Next-Level Breakthroughs, in which many players will gain aspirations to reach even greater heights.
This is not intended to make strong players even stronger. Rather, it will give you more opportunities to use your favourite players.
[p align="start"]As for the new version of Career Mode, we have a grand vision for it.
Its implementation will take some time, and we're still ironing out the details, but keep an eye on future SEGA FCC TV broadcasts and director's letters to learn more.
[p align="start"]Beyond Ver. 3.0, we have tons of developments and ideas that we're excited to bring to the game.
The team is hard at work to make this the best possible experience for all of you. Thank you for being a part of this community.
[p align="start"]With that, let's take a look at the update details for Ver. 2.3.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c8c1c451ddd109ecb6e7472150cce5bf3acf0679.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/306b8fd60ade70e38ef396b5ac2545d503c77db5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/44e57023d32b11ab2dfcf023e5465a947c5ad4d0.png"]World Premiership is getting an update.
1. Removed the ability to change opponents, instead showing 4 potential opponents at once
[p align="start"]Up to now, it was possible to reset when matched with an opponent against whom you had a disadvantage.
Due to the changes to training, including the changes in this update, we expect users would need to spend even more time searching for an opponent they can defeat.
For that reason, we have decided to remove the ability to change your opponent from the game.
2. Master tier switched from a points system to a rating system
[p align="start"]Up to now, you would wait for your match count to increase, play matches, and continually build up your point total based on your match results.
We will do away with that point system for the Master tier, replacing it with a rating system.

Before, rankings were determined by total matches played and total victories while making use of the reset feature, which has a daily limit. This change will make the rankings more a measure of pure team strength.
While the minimum match requirement will remain in place, users will no longer need to rely on the daily reset feature to have any chance at ranking.
3. Matchmaking system adjusted to coincide with the addition of ratings
[p align="start"]With the introduction of ratings, users will now be matched with other managers of a similar rating to them.

This adjustment is also intended to measure and evaluate users' true team strength more accurately. (Since ratings reset each season, this will not be the case for the early season when users haven't played many matches.)
You will still be able to see the other team's Stats.
4. New Legend tier
[p align="start"]We will be adding a new Legend tier above Master 1. As with the Master tier, the Legend tier will also use the new rating system.
As part of the game's design philosophy, we'd like there to be even greater advantages the higher your tier is.
While I can't get into specifics just yet, we are also considering additional systems and updates that will bring even greater advantages.
[p align="start"]For more details, keep an eye on the Manager Notes and News pages.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/a662c5bc4852a787274e448d8e9a27c1a68498a0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/99d2af048cdabe9c3e1d9ed0336b552e160c720e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/4e446857f1b3ad1e9eaf1cfa4b0e1b94f9528d35.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/9ffdb105e7f83a653d1ec9d242d9a3e9ab25350d.png"]The brand-new SFCC Box Event is headed your way.
While not available immediately post-update, this event is on the horizon.
In this event, users can use items obtained by spending Incentive Points to draw from an event-exclusive reward lineup.
The SFCC Box differs from previous Scouting and Training Card Pack lineups.
The number of rewards in the lineup is pre-determined. You can choose to pull everything in the box, or move on to the next box at any time.
For more details, keep an eye out for the announcement once the event is underway.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/8ac4fa23bcb5f66b8bb380a04eccb04a3c8f164a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/cc443fe1e619a0c9c6d5d2848a849a6a7e436aad.png"]As many of you have been requesting, you will now be able to lock your Squads.
It will still be possible to tag your teams, which we added to prevent the accidental deletion of Squads.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fde45906082792af31ae36bc63214954ae4a174b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d15a2fa5ecdd0ec2892ce39e24e11bcbdd2fe996.png"]To allow for different training styles, we made it possible to freely select Breakthroughs for your players.

However, we have noticed that most people select the initial recommended Breakthrough type. As a result, in this update, we have added a setting allowing you to skip the selection and default to the recommended Breakthrough.

notes.title: Skipping Predicaments for joining and leaving the club

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/f9b71a335a3aa7a0c0deda88e968f50327c8aa03.png"]It is now possible to skip Predicaments where a scouted player joins or leaves the club.

notes.title: League Level will default to previous selection

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c88881b7544febba168d1ba87155a063cfec94a2.png"]Whether you're trying to train players, get accessories, or clear higher-level leagues, the league level you choose will change depending on your goals.
Especially when you've cleared every league level and are looking to train your players at a lower one, it's a pain to have to lower your level every time.
We decided this needed a fix, so the game will now remember your previously selected league level.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/32d1ced895f1944679d924deb12cb6fd9ac45528.png"]You can now lock and assign tags to Training Card.

notes.title: Added a button to switch between skills, abilities, or both on the Special Training screen

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/0392ed27ae6a363c7810c61d8d7f7196f4c755a8.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/bfb97d74291f3e7f4bc935f103812944c4648bd3.png"]When selecting Training Cards, it's currently difficult to tell whether your player will learn a skill or ability. This change should make it easier to distinguish between them.
Match Adjustments

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/5f6d05cab2e50e68fd78551dded50e301585e0f6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/dba2ee77b3ea7ba84fdde1033c45c74e6e0cc046.png"]Two changes have been made for matches.
1. Adjustments to trigger rates and timings of Showstoppers
[p align="start"]One aspect of this game is Showstoppers, an iconic mechanic in the series.
However, many of you are disappointed with the current state of Showstoppers, where players lose the ball immediately after they end.
We've taken that feedback to heart, and we've decided to fix it.

In maintaining the balance of the game while elevating the value of the mechanic, we have fixed the issue, but Showstoppers themselves will now occur less frequently than they did in and before Ver. 2.2.
This change is directly connected to the game logic that determines what plays are worthy enough to become Showstoppers.
While Showstoppers are less frequent now, this will not have an impact on game balance.
2. Adjusted effectiveness of Manager Calls
[p align="start"]We have adjusted the effectiveness of Manager Calls, which only occur during one-on-one matchups.
Just like in point 1 above, many of you aren't happy with the fact that you can lose the ball immediately after winning a Manager Call, so we've fixed the issue.
Unlike the change made to Showstoppers, this is meant to impact the balance of matches, so the trigger rate will remain unchanged.

notes.title: Adjusted designs of fixed skills / abilities outside Inheritance Slots

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d02709c85b83ddf1dc7d988355fd6b4d8573ff2d.png"]Each player has skills or abilities that cannot be overwritten through inheritance, but there's no visual cue to distinguish them from normal skills and abilities.
We've now made it easier to distinguish between them.
Added 'Approach' filter at Medal Traders
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/faeed8aa06bbaef477017e352eb7ff12749938cf.png"]You can now sort by approaches at Medal Traders.

notes.title: The following changes have been made

items.text: [p align="start"]• Added club affiliation info to players
• Added max Stats value to Player Details
• Added 'Not Owned' filter at Medal Traders
• On the loan screen, adjusted function when selecting the loaned player
• On the post-match screen, you can now switch between your Team Stats and Starter Stats
• Adjusted unnatural movements during matches
*Has no impact on Match Results

Incentive Points[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/a4e2c82d061324bd60ee1231af435c5891c5216e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/5dfde7c7cf00a456330c778474b33bb28f7a74c6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/cf15c57d27e8931a8a5b3142f3a2a2ee134e60e0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/83219a2671180b67c26ff2165a36b540ad347a2e.png"]We've added Incentive Points, which you can use at the end of each Career Mode season.
These will provide a greater sense of day-to-day progression in Career Mode, complementing features such as player registration.
You recover 3 Incentive Points each day at the daily reset (19:00 GMT), up to a maximum of 5.
You can spend Incentive Points on item drops, with rewards increasing based on the amount you spend.
Whether you play a little each day or save them for the weekend, feel free to use them as you see fit.
The main items you can earn through Incentive Points are Player Upgrade Modules, Trainer Upgrade Modules, and Accessories (covered later).
*Accessories are not available from drop draws in certain League Levels. Please check each league's reward list for details.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/9c2966217bbf779351874ea9a318788ea041dd9f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/82ad926dd826034253e31a44cce9ae23ba67203d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/bcd654f7fcc90a6988b83e14d2a6928428082257.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/1ab982c7dcd17549d0ddd67bdb9e4ac00fd8f26a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/b0ca1e640d8fcf743922364051f3163af12d01de.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d2740a41bbb414c6d6d6ff74cd02c2f26c5b2019.png"]Introduced alongside Incentive Points, Accessories allow you to further upgrade your Prime Players.*Equipping an Accessory to a Prime Player will also equip it to registered versions of the player. Equipping through a registered player's details screen will also apply it to the Prime Player, making managing equipment easy.
There are three types of Accessories, each boosting different attributes.
These Accessories can be upgraded using your unwanted Accessories.
As you play Career Mode and spend Incentive Points, you'll gradually collect and upgrade Accessories.
Accessories feature Full Set Effects based on their rarity, as well as random bonus effects.
Some of the effects offer Play Instinct modifiers.
With this addition, players are no longer limited to their default Play Instinct values, opening up new ways to build and experiment with your team.
High-rarity Accessories can be obtained by playing at higher League Levels.

While we considered using a single Accessory pool across all Leagues, we wanted everyone to be able to target specific Accessories and bonus effects. As such, each League has its own selection of Accessories.
For more details, check the Manager Notes in-game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/527bff05b131286daabb291a7ad4197d7624f95e.png"]We'll be introducing the SFCC Coin Event at a later date.
During the event, you can earn SFCC Coins by spending Incentive Points.
These Coins can then be exchanged for a variety of items at the limited-time Trader.
We hope you'll enjoy the event while making the most of the new Career Mode features.
Stay tuned!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/765e23176d552a1808f1cee92025a63736b17297.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fbf70f4459ecd22e946c8b53e963ea7522d6a761.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/e7a24f9cde188119a11c92302115f48c38d1e689.png"]The SFCC Quiz is also coming soon.

Many users pick up tips from guides and posts on X, and we wanted to bring those 'I didn't know that!' moments into the game itself. That's why we created the SFCC Quiz, where your gameplay knowledge will be put to the test.
Submit your answers in-game, then check back the following day to see how you did.
Please note that once you've submitted your answers, they cannot be changed.
The event features two types of rewards: one for submitting your answers and another for answering correctly.
Stay tuned!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/a8a64c17bef9012a21a303e7b22ede0d5beccbe4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c41058d53162e6f31fb256533e5bb2e3645c5c59.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/3cee6e5154726c89558008112566ca35304e13bf.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/3f0f65e811239660b881a297543f10acc675c174.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/15f8e1c7d51fd097fa53bb9bac58b1cf47b0ac85.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/dba1135a3f2676f2ec3557488f2b2a8b72d60cca.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/4577d830e9eed9bc5c8f99bde67e6b600282b28c.png"]We've now added the exclusive titles and original in-game players promised as rewards for the 1st SFCC Ultimate Manager Japan Championship, held before the first roster update.
The Stats of these players reflect their rankings in the final tournament.
Be sure to check them out in Career Mode!
Creating and implementing these players took longer than expected, and we sincerely apologise for the wait.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/6e64c69b350af52ab18cb26771e2127e2d64f42d.png"]We've redesigned the Trader screen.
Previously, you had to return to the previous page each time you wanted to browse a different Trader. Now, like the Scouting screen, you can switch between Traders directly from the bar on the left.
We know this improvement has been a long time coming. With the SFCC Coin Event on the way, we felt now was the right time to make this change.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/4dd68e487329f9971321c0324e1f92e6e00381a9.png"]Many users have told us it was difficult to distinguish between the bronze and gold designs used for skills and abilities.
After many refinements, these changes are coming in Ver. 2.2.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/6580983533ae2c5dced0d680b5469f681760724b.png"]After acquiring a stronger version of a registered player in Career Mode, updating every Squad with that player was a bit tedious. We've added a new feature to alleviate that issue.
When swapping a registered player in any Squad with another registered player of the same name, you can now choose to swap every instance of that player across your Squads with the stronger version.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/b9d24568c4e823095dae20b118ce22f6cac69588.png"]Up to Ver. 2.1:
• Chance for Inheritance event to trigger gradually increased based on a player's time at the club
• Could not occur for a set period after the player joined
From Ver. 2.2
• Inheritance event occurs at a fixed probability during the Plateauing and Declining phases
• No longer becomes more likely based on time at the club
With this change, if you have a player in the Declining phase, an Inheritance event is now likely to occur within a single season.
Previously, you had to wait for the event and hope it lined up with the player you wished to train's ideal Stage of Development. This change is intended to make the process more predictable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/09ef7cb34837739fcaedf537c0d9ddf30a9213a9.png"]Some players have been particularly difficult to sign through Direct Offers. By addressing the following two areas, we've increased the success rate of these offers.
1. Increased Scouting Expertise from Manager Level
Previously, Scouting Expertise stopped increasing at Manager Lv. 20. From this update, it will continue to increase from Lv. 21 through Lv. 50.
2. Direct Offer success rate adjustments
Alongside the Inheritance changes above, we've rebalanced Direct Offer success rates to reduce the difficulty of acquiring and training players.
Other

notes.title: The following changes have been made

items.text: • Added Squad numbers
• Image silhouette adjustments
• Direct Offer search results now remember your selection
• Added match result details for promotion play-off draws
• Adjusted Tutorial Missions and Tour Missions
*If you've already completed these missions, this change will not affect you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/8c390b4987c06ff5a8c474d742c52055eb332157.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/39aeab8029de852907d77ad3950a0edcf8672493.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/5f2dcfffb85601e05c957a9e0d62cc14d88f8ba8.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/6b890510e147d20aa80fd42ccffefaf06605c6eb.png"]
[p align="start"]Following the update, the International Cup Event will be available for a limited time.
In this event, choose one of 16 nations and compete to become tournament champions.
Earn a variety of rewards based on your final ranking.
[p align="start"]You can also customise each national team by using your own Prime Players and Formation Combos.
In addition, gain points through your managerial achievements and performance in the event, then use them to upgrade players from each nation.
Since this isn't an event that comes around every day, we're making it available for an extended period. Get out there and lead all 16 nations to glory!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/b05cda1ac0996deede21fb90473309fe642a7373.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fe466106c87adfa271e6b7d0481eed7cdafab20a.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/91399c69b9bf48e8c49e8b1a3f0173bcef0d4128.png"]
[p align="start"]We're also launching Special 1v1, an all-new real-time competitive event.
[p align="start"]Running for one week only, try out practice matches to learn the rules, then take on intense standard matches against other users when they're available during the weekend.
Because this is a real-time competitive event, match times have been condensed to ensure everyone can easily join matches and find suitable opponents.
*Please check the event announcement for details on the event schedule.
[p align="start"]The event also features a special rules that change with each iteration.
In doing this, we hope to create opportunities for players with lower attributes to shine, offering users the chance to branch out and train a whole new squad of footballers.
[p align="start"]You can play up to nine standard matches during each event, and the rewards you earn increase with your number of wins.
This event is a great way to earn SSR Training Card Pieces, so don't miss out!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/3cbfb2406982bf798be46c4da68dcf74bb5036c0.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/67499805edb774d385bb6aa436373b1e0bab0e12.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/67499805edb774d385bb6aa436373b1e0bab0e12.png"]
[p align="start"]With many users wanting to respec their teams and upgrade the new players added in the Roster Update, we've introduced the feature to do just that.
[p align="start"]It costs GB to reset. Without the cost, the optimal way to play would be to simply respec every time you need to use certain players for matches or Career Mode.
[p align="start"]Though the use cases are limited, we hope it comes in handy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/df1932b24b06dde0ea9e0cf93d8d07189823c27d.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/8a4176da001d7270d1ead47bcbf6c7021668a481.png"]
[p align="start"]To further streamline the game, we've added new Direct Offer settings.
Unchecking the option shown above will disable the sequence that plays when a Direct Offer is rejected.
It's a minor change, but we'd like to continue building on these small time-saving improvements to make the game better over time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/532bbb8a6671e9da5509f7d213b56ebdcae84634.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/bf17412b6e52f47c5f1681345c2a016c32745a5d.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/ab409ec1e1fdcad675fc2c65b76f86d2a62e999f.png"]
[p align="start"]The Underdog, Three Consecutive Wins, Ten Consecutive Wins, Hat-Trick animations can now be skipped by tapping the screen or with other inputs.
We're implementing this feature due to the number of requests we receivedd after making a similar change to the champion sequence in Career Mode.
We welcome any feedback you have on ways we can streamline the game more, and thank you for your continued support.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d85878c13d8f284f2e6eef1791c2979ab28d6ef6.png"]
[p align="start"]Previously, no actions could be taken while funds were being deducted after loaning a player. With this update, you can now navigate menus and search for other players to loan.
We made this change based on feedback, and because we felt it frustrated many people that it wasn't already an option.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/529f84f022e9e517a45ce0a30a5530439dc89dbc.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/c3269a62fb6599ba24b2fb6e7d485b48c77a0cd9.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/a1d9800e588120c8aa00068c9aa5fccf70c70728.png"]
[p align="start"]We made some highly requested improvements to tournaments.
[p align="start"]1. You can host tournaments without participating
2. Tournaments will now start immediately after all participants have readied up
[p align="start"]These are both long-requested features, and though they took some time to implement, they're finally here. We hope they improve the tournament experience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/9083d8c2286b707fc87994dff06d7d050dee0dcd.png"]
[p align="start"]Previously, the Items menu was located under Menu > Other > Items, but now that there are more selectable items, we've moved it to a location that's easier to access.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/514cf227a9ed1741075d245ed08f0da2a03c08e9.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/aa8be758e529b49469955220379576fa69cd3f9c.jpg"]
[p align="start"]We've added a 'Previous Scouting Results' option to the Scouting screen.
If you're unable to view your Scouting results for any reason, you'll be able to check them here.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/a3984e89ce17d747c74f225c755af28c30dd9faf.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/2efda21ff7081f8d1ce328f513e5dc2af7d23775.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fe13e4f82a22b75db6a06b17a04e257d92044b74.png"]
[p align="start"]Previously, we updated the MCO chat so that restricted words are replaced with '*' when posted. This has now been extended to MCO descriptions, Owner's Comments, and user profiles.

notes.title: [p align="start"]The following changes have been made

items.text: [p align="start"]• Added Yuka Kageyama to Assistant Selection
• Added club emblems and kit designs
• Added the Archive Coin Trader

topNew: [p align="start"]To further streamline the game, we've added new Direct Offer settings.

items.text: Renaud's first challenge will begin after maintenance.
Face off against the man himself across 20 difficulty levels.
Clear levels 1–10 to earn various rewards at each level, and conquer level 20 to unlock a special title..
For more details about this event, please see here.
For a limited time, the Aburano Sponsor will appear in Career Mode.
Limited-time loan destinations will also be available in Career Mode. Send your players to them to boost their playstyle level.
Information on featured playstyles and more will be announced in-game.
4 new Formation Combos have been added, which can be obtained by reaching Manager Lv. 10 or higher.

notes.title: World Premiership Rewards and UI Improvements[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/780499811d0c4c323a7ec4cd0e70c558f996dd84.jpg"]

items.text: In response to feedback regarding Upgrade Boots, rewards (excluding World Premiership Coins) will be doubled from this version onward.
We have also expanded the reward display area to improve its design and functionality.
It will now be possible to delete multiple Squads at once.

notes.title: Fatigue Now Displayed During Team Training[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/f8e30ecd667331f2739a217d3f6ddec5fcc3e4a0.jpg"]

items.text: Previously, you could only view fatigue when selecting Stretch.
Fatigue will now be visible no matter which training programme you pick.
In Ver. 1.2, a number of settings could be changed from different screens.
There were also some that could only be changed at specific timings, such as at the end of the season.
In Ver. 1.3, these settings have been consolidated to the Career Home screen.
When adding Prime Players to the team, it was difficult to check formations and stage of development.
To address this, we have added a function that allows you to view your current team lineup.

notes.title: Prioritise Approach Added to Auto Lineup[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/79bab1d5dfec6ecdd63fda86518f3a7d8fa1f9b4.jpg"]

items.text: Added "Approach" to the priority conditions when pressing auto-formation on the selection team formation screen.

notes.title: Direct Offer Settings Can Now Be Saved[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/179b896aa4d70fc60c09ba60cf2797bc8613f605.jpg"]

items.text: You can now save player search conditions for Direct Offers separately for each save slot.
It is now possible to view information about the club making an offer for your players.
We have adjusted the red notification badges, such as one-on-one interview notifications on the Edit Team screen, to make them easier to see.
When you finish a season with a specific club and move to a new one, the financial status of your previous club will now be maintained.
A 'Recommended' option has been added when selecting players to loan.
The loan destination that offers the greatest overall stat increase will now be selected by default.
You can now assign tags to registered players.
We have implemented a new type of ticket that allows you to reset your save data without using GB.

notes.title: The following improvements have also been made

items.text: • Lowered the required Manager Level for the Formation Coin Trader.
• Added Traders to the shortcut menu.
• Added the quantity of items owned next to each icon on the Trader screen.
• You can now tap the screen to skip certain Career Mode scenes, such as International Tournaments and Cup Matches.
• Training Cards can now be sorted and filtered by Playstyle.
• Adjusted icons that show after investments and Special Training.
• Improved gamepad control.

topNew: 4 new Formation Combos have been added, which can be obtained by reaching Manager Lv. 10 or higher.
We have also expanded the reward display area to improve its design and functionality.
Added "Approach" to the priority conditions when pressing auto-formation on the selection team formation screen.

items.text: • If you sort or filter and there are no eligible players, the button disappears, making it impossible to change screens.
• Player sales may fail due to an error.
• The effects of a position aptitude bonus are not reflected on some screens.
All of the issues listed above will be fixed in Version 1.2.
We would like to once again apologise for the inconvenience caused.
Various other minor bug fixes will also be implemented.
The Dice Event will begin after maintenance ends.

In this event, use the dice you've obtained through missions to move around the board, earning rewards for each space you land on. If you stop on certain spaces, you can even take a shot at the Kick the Target minigame.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/fcf0b5f0fc5383f35bc43e176a62c575ac958ca2.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/7cc8bc048148a18f74dd140f841f0ae96231c16a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/b84e03c0b64716465e8af10456d8eb5aafbbb802.jpg"]

Kick the Target features a range of rewards, including Prime Scouting Tickets and 10 Training Card Tickets among the top prizes. You can add a multiplier to your dice depending on how many you have, making it possible to obtain up to 100 tickets at once! You'll only have three chances to hit the target, so make every kick count!
For more details, refer to the post-maintenance notice.

This has been one of our most requested features, and we apologise that we weren't able to include it in the previous version. At the end of the season, you will now be able to toggle skipping on or off via the settings button next to Advance Schedule.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/6f6ee3a9a2c0cd5f3e422ebfaae4698bff168758.jpg"]

We've received plenty of feedback asking for features such as bulk locking, bulk deletion, and renaming. While we haven't been able to implement every request, we will be adding a tagging feature for Squads as a temporary solution. With this feature, you can assign tags to Squads. For example, you can set different tags for each of the four approaches so they're easier to tell apart. You can also use tags to mark Squads that you use frequently.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d2657d2b5d109b388b821201f39918b4ead4b1c8.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/4d64ec7c02545c0dbd5b5e3dbfec034855b2288f.jpg"]

This new feature will be accessible via Menu > Other > Items, enabling you to select between multiple possible rewards. For example, you'll be able to pick one of the available Prime Players, or choose between a J.League or K League 1 Prime Scouting Ticket. Many variations of this item type will be added in the future.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/989a254670fadd8d1464c187bfc0231df8b7e4cb.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/02200a8c28e7386571a76c20cfae1262c587c3ac.jpg"]

A selectable reward is available in the New Assistant Debut Login Bonus that will begin after maintenance finishes. Four different Training Cards will be available. You can aim to collect all four types, or focus on one type and obtain multiple copies to perform Limit Breaks.

notes.title: Playstyle Level Search Added to Scouting List and Direct Offers

items.text: We will be adding the ability to search for players by playstyle level, such as Attacker II or Dribbler III, in both the Scouting List and Direct Offers.
This should help when recruiting players for specific Formation Combos.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/d3b3062f7a58356eccfb8d3b1dcb2c2e5cca2f3e.jpg"]

Score Bonus animations could play repeatedly, preventing users from viewing important information. An update scheduled for April will address the problem where scrolling causes the animation to play again. We apologise for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/ca3e39d8c6b1f6e39517abfff2c9161e30029918.jpg"]

The timing of mission completion notifications, such as 'Win a match', will be adjusted to prevent them from appearing before the results are displayed on screen.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/77a549fcc43c7b184adc13ceeb636018b666ce73.jpg"]

At the moment, whenever you confirm a Squad, you have to return to the previous screen using the button in the top-left corner. This will be changed so that the screen automatically transitions once the Squad has been confirmed.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/cc46b84224143f9255a6908b939012d2670b85b1.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640796/38c60b65fda447e4b4a3df63b20ba9de30b2cc0f.jpg"]
